CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: fix(net): CRITICAL -- other players were never rendered anywhere online (PlayerState.id never set in the networked snapshot path, breaking the self-exclusion draw filter for every other player too). Found via a real 2-client Xvfb test. Affects every networked mode, not just QUEUE (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
